Add opt-in sidebar grouping for conversation versions ([#12](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/12)) and support official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` while retaining `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.5` compatibility.

- **Opt-in sidebar grouping (off by default):** Enable **Settings → Message editing → Group versions into one sidebar entry** (`侧栏同一对话只显示一个入口` / `Объединять версии диалога в один пункт боковой панели`) to collapse an original conversation and its recorded edit/retry version family into the original root row in the sidebar and search results while keeping all branches in the **Versions** tab and `‹ n/m ›` switcher.
- **Lineage, ownership, and activity semantics:**
  - Only sessions with recorded parent lineage are grouped. Native independent conversation copies (such as **Branch into a new conversation** in DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`, which deliberately omits parent lineage) remain separate root entries. Orphan branches remain visible and subagents are never merged into ordinary conversation versions.
  - The grouped row retains the root session's actual title, workspace membership, pin state, and archive state; pinning or archiving the grouped row acts only on the root session and never batch-archives, deletes, or rewrites family branches.
  - Latest activity timestamps, running states, and running subagent counts (`runningChildCount`) are aggregated across the family.
- **Actionable status and click priority:**
  - Projected status indicators and ordinary grouped-row clicks use the same eligible, visible, non-archived ordinary family members (preferring the original root first within each priority level, then native catalog order):
    1. Eligible pending interaction (`approval`, `plan-review`, or `question`) first,
    2. Eligible unread completion next,
    3. Remembered non-archived version (when **Remember the version I was viewing** is enabled) or the original root as fallback.
  - Actionable status temporarily takes priority over the remembered version so hidden attention states remain reachable. Only the session actually opened is acknowledged by the host (no automatic family-wide mark-read), so multiple unread versions can be visited individually on subsequent clicks.
  - Clicking a search result with an explicit content snippet (or a unique hidden-version match) opens that matched version directly, taking precedence over pending/unread status and the remembered version.
- **Known non-blocking search caveats:**
  1. In **Show archived** (`All conversations`), when the root is live and only archived hidden versions match a content search, the grouped hit can render with the live root's styling and without an inline `Unarchive` button; clicking clears search and shows the native archived-session notice (`Archived sessions cannot be opened. Unarchive it to view.`) without navigating or unarchiving. Unarchive the version via the **Versions** tab or the ungrouped archived view.
  2. When full-text search is disabled and multiple hidden versions share a matching title (without the root title matching), clicking the deduplicated family hit opens a matching version (the first eligible match), not necessarily the remembered version.
  3. On older hosts (`0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.5`), grouped fallback search matches hidden version session IDs while native ordinary/root session-ID search is unsupported; DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` supports session-ID search for all sessions.
- **Official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` compatibility and UI polish:**
  - Admit `0.2.2-rc.1` (upstream tag `dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1`, commit `66491b05e3f05ad35bcdd4f6cd7ed26041d9e3db`) in `peerDependencies` and `engines.dsh` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`). Official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` requires Node `>=24.9.0`; the plugin retains Node `22.19+` and Node `24` compatibility for earlier supported DSH hosts.
  - Mark replaced user-message text nodes as native text-interaction sources for DSH `0.2.2` selection and Quote insertion, keep grouped search callbacks stable across streaming catalog/status updates, and use `--dsw-alias-bg-base` (with `Canvas` fallback) for light-theme version card and control contrast.

新增可选的「侧栏同一对话只显示一个入口」版本合并功能（[#12](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/12)），并支持官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`（同时保持对 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.5` 的兼容支持）：

- **可选侧栏合并（默认关闭）**：在 **设置 → 消息编辑** 中开启「侧栏同一对话只显示一个入口」，可将带记录谱系的原始会话及其编辑/重试分支合并为单个侧栏与搜索入口，所有分支仍完整保留在「版本」树与 `‹ n/m ›` 切换器中。宿主原生无父谱系的独立复制会话（如 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 的「分支为新对话」）保持为独立根入口；孤立分支保持可见，子智能体不并入普通会话版本。
- **根会话归属、活动聚合与状态跳转优先级**：合并入口保留根会话真实的标题、工作区、置顶与归档状态（归档仅作用于根会话本身），并汇总家族运行状态与运行中子智能体计数。普通点击按「待处理交互（`approval`/`plan-review`/`question`）→ 未读完成 → 记住的未归档版本 / 原始根会话」优先级跳转（同优先级内优先根会话，其次按宿主目录顺序），仅对实际打开的会话确认已读，多个未读分支可逐次点击访问；带显式正文摘要（或唯一命中隐藏分支）的搜索结果直接打开命中的具体版本。
- **已知非阻塞搜索说明**：（1）「显示已归档」下若根会话未归档而仅有已归档隐藏分支命中正文，合并结果沿用未归档根会话样式且无行内取消归档按钮，点击会清空搜索并显示宿主原生已归档提示，需从「版本」页或关闭合并后的原生列表取消归档；（2）全文搜索关闭且多个隐藏分支同名匹配（根不匹配）时，点击打开首个符合条件的匹配分支而非必为记住的版本；（3）旧版宿主（`0.2.0-rc.2`/`0.2.1-rc.2`/`0.2.1-rc.5`）原生不支持普通/根会话 ID 搜索（开启合并时回退搜索可匹配隐藏分支 ID），`0.2.2-rc.1` 原生支持全部会话 ID 搜索。
- **DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 兼容与界面细节**：在 `peerDependencies` 与 `engines.dsh` 中显式纳入 `0.2.2-rc.1`（DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` 要求 Node `>=24.9.0`，旧版宿主继续保持 Node `22.19+` / `24` 兼容），支持 DSH `0.2.2` 用户消息划词引用（Quote），保持流式输出期间搜索回调稳定，并修复浅色主题下版本树卡片与控件背景对比度。

Thanks to [@ganpig](https://github.com/ganpig) for contributing the opt-in sidebar grouping feature and its `Versions`-tree and locale integration in [#12](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-message-edit/pull/12).

Validation: 102 automated tests (including 43 sidebar projection, search, and actionable-status tests), 4 release-tool tests, 10 publishing-helper unit tests, 13-file npm package verification, fresh-boot and restart API acceptance across official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, and `0.2.2-rc.1`, and isolated real-browser Web acceptance on official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and `0.2.1-rc.5` with an offline model.

Install from npm or the attached release archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-message-edit
```

Restart DSH after updating.
